verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's docs have a dedicated SDK section describing "Official SDKs for integrating Hyperbrowser into your applications" and name the SDKs as a primary control path alongside Puppeteer and Playwright. Sandbox docs also show SDK setup and code calls such as `sandbox.exec`. Missing for 10: which languages the SDKs cover, in-depth SDK reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
